subject: Aligning next architecture review, access notes, and invite
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@carewell.io>, Tom Hargreaves <tom@carewell.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning next architecture review, access notes, and invite

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to understand CareWell's latency and compliance constraints for the first phase. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the architecture review: 

- Recap: you need a hosted POC for user-facing triage that keeps 95th percentile latency <200ms for short prompts, plus an audit log retention requirement of 12 months.
- Goals for the architecture review: review model selection (quantized vs full precision), network egress pattern for PHI-safe routing, and IAM/KMS integration for keys.

Proposed next meeting: a 60-minute architecture review with our infra and security leads. I shaded three windows below in your timezone (PST). Please pick whichever works best and add any technical stakeholders from your side.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Dec 16, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Dec 17, 14:00–15:00
- Fri Dec 18, 09:30–10:30

Attendees suggested from our side: Marcus Lin (infra lead), Neha Kapoor (security/compliance). From CareWell: engineering lead + security/ops (if possible).

I've attached a short MVP scope doc and an ops access checklist to speed any pre-meeting prep. If you confirm a slot, I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short pre-read.

Next step ask: Can you confirm preferred slot and list of attendees by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks — looking forward.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@carewell.io>

Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom@carewell.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning next architecture review, access notes, and invite

Diego —

Thanks for the clear recap. We can do Thu Dec 17, 14:00–15:00 PST. I will join, and I’ve asked Raj Patel (engineering lead) and Mira Gonzalez (security ops) to join as well — copying Tom who will coordinate on our side.

Notes: Raj will want to review the quantization tradeoffs and Mira will bring a list of our current KMS/HSM constraints. Also, we need to confirm whether Redwood requires a VPN or if we can use IP allowlisting during the POC (Mira prefers allowlist).

If you can send the invite with the Zoom link and include the short pre-read, we’ll review before the call.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
CareWell Health
